query.sql: select to_char(date_trunc('month', "lancamentos"."data_lancamento"), 'YYYY-MM') as "competencia", coalesce(sum("valor") FILTER (WHERE "tipo" = 'entrada'), 0)::text as "entradas", coalesce(sum("valor") FILTER (WHERE "tipo" = 'saida'), 0)::text as "saidas" from "lancamentos" where ("lancamentos"."data_lancamento" >= $1 and "lancamentos"."data_lancamento" < $2 and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "estornos" WHERE "estornos"."idlancamento" = "lancamentos"."idlancamento")) group by date_trunc('month', "lancamentos"."data_lancamento") order by date_trunc('month', "lancamentos"."data_lancamento")
